title: Network baseline
content: The private Hosted Agent template has no public fallback topology. Foundry, Search, and Key Vault public data-plane access is disabled.

title: Identity baseline
content: The Hosted Agent uses its dedicated runtime identity and has query-only Search Index Data Reader permission. It has no client secret.

title: CMK baseline
content: Foundry and the Search demo index use separate customer-managed keys named cmk-foundry and cmk-search in one protected Key Vault.
